findings.description: The server state probe never reports the lock state of USE_FISHING_ROD (null in all 34 state lines), contrary to the brief's row anatomy. The lock is still provable from count < threshold in the state line, the ability-specific client overlay text and the absence of effect, so verdicts are reproducible, but the server-side excerpt alone does not show the lock state.

The locked excerpts contain no plugin decision line (no ATD_EVENT/ATD_W2/packet-in line for the cast): only the bobber probe, the count and two container-resync packets. The denial is attested by the missing bobber plus the client overlay recorded in rows.jsonl. Verdicts are reproducible, but the server log does not itself show the PlayerFishEvent cancellation.
